title: Holy Sh*t Tesla
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: Calls 5.27% the peak 10-year yield; falling rates would boost rate-sensitive names like Tesla and Enphase.
An Iran deal plus peak yields could send Tesla sharply higher.
Risk to Tesla's European share, but no one rivals FSD yet.

calls.condition: Iran deal / peak yields help it reach 414.
calls.reason: Q3 deliveries 486,532 nearly matched tax-credit-boosted prior year; bottoming above 347; DCF ~$824 by end-2030. Valuation still elevated (PEG ~4.8).
calls.quote: the next line is 414 and I think we'll uh we'll we'll head on over there um soon enough.

calls.reason: Believes 5.27% is the peak in yields.

calls.condition: If yields have peaked and its data-center converter option plays out.
calls.reason: Bottoming after brutal rate-hike decline; ~$4.4B with a data-center call option.
calls.quote: if we get peak yields and Nphas's data center call option plays out, this is a dirt cheap competitor.

calls.reason: Dirt cheap with robotics/vehicle verticals; breaking out of the 227 line to all-time highs.
calls.quote: I've been very, very, very bullish on Nvidia... they're at alltime highs today. Finally breaking out of that 227 line.

notes: Recorded the day Tesla reported Q3 deliveries (stock +5%, SpaceX up with it); matches Friday 2026-10-02 (listing approx 2026-10-03). Date inferred from context, not stated. 10y quoted as '527/526' = 5.27%/5.26%. SpaceX mentioned only as moving with Tesla.
